correctness.rationale: The complete RREF search over 2,558,556 nets is cross-checked by two different implementations and coefficient-set equality. Exact determinant tests select precisely 8000, four projectivity generators partition them 4000+4000, all 508431 pencils are independently counted, and all 124000 smooth pencils are seen exactly twice with opposite orbit labels. Exact Groebner ideals certify three versus zero geometric rank-one conics with projective boundaries and an irreducible separable cubic. Evaluation checks rational point permutations.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural finite-field classification, not a routine existence example: it distinguishes two projective orbits by the geometric Veronese intersection, proves every smooth conic pencil admits precisely two opposite-type extensions, and identifies degree-two point permutations. The unknown exact fixed-field invariant is motivated directly by smooth linear systems and projective symmetry.
